name: Non-periodic Photon Sieve Holographic Display
definition: A holographic display technique using a deterministically generated pseudorandom mask (photon sieve) consisting of pinholes to redistribute optical modes from an LCD panel into a large optical mode space, enabling wide viewing angles and large-area projection without time-consuming calibration.
summary: The Non-periodic Photon Sieve Holographic Display is a flat-panel technique using a pseudorandom pinhole mask to overcome Spatial Light Modulator limits, enabling large, wide-angle holographic images.
